behavior: Rejected file/eval sources retain completed encoding headers before malformed Unicode or deferred heredoc segments. Declarations already parsed inside interpolation survive a later segment error; a heredoc indentation pre-scan failure can prevent them. Harmless escaped, single-quoted/nowdoc, maximum-codepoint and admitted surrogate controls do not create false cutoffs.
implementation: New native php_spec_lex_eval(bytes) and php_spec_lex_file_rejected(path) share a parser-mode lexical loop, never zendparse or compilation/evaluation. ON_TOKEN retains skipped trivia and original bytes/positions, normalizes close/short-echo tags and omits END/T_ERROR. The first token compensates for discarded file shebang lines. Value-token AST_ZVAL leaves are destroyed once, a private arena is freed and saved lexical/compiler flags are restored; decoded values and diagnostic answers are not exported. RejectedEvalLexer/RejectedFileLexer feed only rejectedHeaderFacts. The accepted FileLexer/EvalLexer and original scan_file body, worker/adapter/schema and every authored P4 rule remain unchanged.
